variants.name: 细黑边流金
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit target is the attached original-in-this-project game logo. Exact ONLY text: "逆转五丈原", correctly written simplified Chinese characters. User chose this composition and now requests BLACK AND GOLD with visible BLACK EDGES, and notably more graceful free-flowing calligraphy in the first two characters 逆转. Preserve wide horizontal title, relative arrangement (逆转 left, 五丈原 right), overall strong historic tone and the readable substantial brush skeleton of 五丈原. REDESIGN 逆转 as bespoke original hand-lettered forms: more open counters, supple longer curved strokes, expressive thick-to-thin modulation, elongated tapered dry-brush tips, a lifting return stroke on 逆 and graceful descending then upward-curving finish on 转. These two characters should feel freely flowing and airy while still strong, NOT same blocky glyphs recolored. Keep every character anatomically correct and instantly recognizable; never substitute traditional 轉 or decorative pseudo-writing. Do not use a named font, do not imitate any existing game logo, brand, artist or calligrapher. Make custom letterforms from scratch guided only by this project's attached image. Retain the sharp upright heavier 五丈原 to balance the floating first pair. Restrained precious aged gold and matte near-black only, no red, teal, green, white main strokes. Intrinsic fine brushed metal and worn gold-leaf texture, shallow tactile depth, no excessive extruded 3D, plastic gloss, cheap bright yellow, magic glow or spark particles. Black border follows expressive stroke contours and gaps, not an equal-width rounded sticker stroke. No letters fused or crossed by flourishes. Only one completed title logo on true transparent background, no black rectangle or scene, all tips contained with safe margins, landscape aspect about 3:1. No added wording, English, stamps, logos, captions, watermark, icons, weapons or ornament unrelated to lettering. Variant 01: luminous pale aged-gold letter faces occupy 85 percent of each stroke, a precise slender but clearly visible charcoal-black cut edge occupies about 15 percent, with slight irregular black recesses. Graceful elegant lightness in 逆转, much finer tapered long terminals than the reference, shorter restrained return flourish to avoid bulk. Gold is satin champagne with varied natural metallic grain, highlights controlled and not white. Keep black edges clean and visibly present even on a light backdrop. Elegant historical cinema wordmark.
